title: On the Effectiveness of LLM-as-a-judge for Code Generation and Summarization
authors_zh: Giuseppe Crupi, Rosalia Tufano, Alejandro Velasco, Antonio Mastropaolo, Denys Poshyvanyk, Gabriele Bavota
paper_type_zh: 大语言模型评审可靠性实证研究
best_for_zh: 需要校准代码自动评测或代码奖励信号的研究者。
one_line: Tests whether LLM judges reliably assess code correctness and code-summary quality against executable and human references.
审计大语言模型评审代码正确性和代码摘要质量时的可靠性与失效模式。
why: It quantifies judge failures that can make automated code evaluation or reward signals unsafe.
inclusion_reason: Empirical audit of LLM-judge reliability for code generation and code summarization.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code generators and summarizers need scalable evaluation, but reference-overlap metrics miss valid alternatives and test suites can be weak. Human review is costly, so LLM judging is tempting but must be tested before it is used as an oracle.

The paper measures whether eight LLMs can judge generated Java/Python functions and whether five can score code summaries against human judgments. It audits judgment failures rather than proposing a new generator.

代码生成和摘要需要可扩展的评测，但参考文本重合会漏掉有效替代写法，单元测试也可能过弱。人工评审成本高，因而大语言模型评审很有吸引力，却必须先验证能否充当可靠判据。

论文测量八个模型能否评判 Java/Python 生成函数，并测量五个模型能否按人类判断给代码摘要评分；它审计评审失效，而非提出新的生成模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: This empirical audit separates a judge's ability to emit a verdict from its agreement with executable tests or humans. It tests several prompting strategies, filters unreliable CoderEval tasks, and releases a replication package including a 1,163-summary human-judgment dataset. GPT-4-turbo is best among the tested judges, yet still makes frequent errors; the central artifact is a reliability benchmark, not supervision for training.
这项实证审计区分“模型能否输出判决”和“判决是否同可执行测试或人类一致”。作者比较多种提示策略、剔除不可靠的 CoderEval 题目，并公开复现实验包及含 1,163 条摘要的人类判断数据。GPT-4-turbo 在测试模型中最佳，却仍频繁出错；核心产物是可靠性基准，不是训练监督数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Audit CoderEval tests, retaining 184 Java and 190 Python problems after removing targets or trivial implementations that pass.
  1. Generate candidate functions with eight code LLMs and ask each judge to rate correctness from the description, signature, and candidate; executable tests provide the comparison outcome.
  1. Build a public summary set from 198 long CoderEval functions: human and five-model summaries yield 1,163 records, each judged by three of nine human assessors.
  1. Run four prompts, extract and manually verify verdicts, then compare accuracy, failures, bias, and error types. The replication package is required; proprietary model versions and endpoint behavior remain time-dependent.

1. 审计 CoderEval 测试，去除目标实现或空壳实现也能通过的题目后，保留 184 个 Java 与 190 个 Python 题目。
  1. 用八个代码模型生成候选函数，再让每个评审模型仅根据描述、签名和候选实现判断正确性，以可执行测试作对照。
  1. 从 198 个较长的 CoderEval 函数构建公开摘要集：人类和五个模型生成共 1,163 条摘要，每条由九名人工评审中的三人评分。
  1. 运行四种提示、抽取并人工核验判决，比较准确性、失败、偏差和错误类型。复现需使用实验包；闭源模型版本与接口行为随时间变化。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The core comparison uses executable test outcomes for 2,686 code assessments per judge and three-human ratings for 1,163 summaries. GPT-4-turbo is strongest, but it labels wrong code as correct in 50% of the reported cases; smaller models frequently fail to produce usable verdicts. This supports using an LLM judge as a fallible diagnostic, not as an unattended correctness oracle.
核心比较以每个评审模型 2,686 次代码判断的可执行测试结果，以及 1,163 条摘要的三人评分为对照。GPT-4-turbo 最强，但报告中仍将错误代码的 50% 判为正确；较小模型还常无法输出可用判决。结果支持把大语言模型评审当作有误差的诊断工具，而非无人值守的正确性判据。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier code-judge work largely tests a single task or prompt. This study changes the comparison into a two-task audit with filtered executable or human reference signals, multiple model sizes, prompt variants, self-bias, and error analysis. The novelty is breadth of validation, not the idea of prompting an LLM to judge code.
既有代码评审研究多只测试单一任务或提示词。本文把比较扩展为双任务审计，并使用经筛选的可执行或人工参考信号、不同规模模型、提示词变体、自偏好和错误分析。新意是验证范围，而不是“提示大语言模型评判代码”这个想法本身。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Code tests are an imperfect oracle: the authors found trivial implementations that pass CoderEval, and missing context or ambiguous requirements also create apparent judge errors. The summary study covers selected long functions and nine annotators. Reuse requires an independent test-suite audit and human calibration on the target repository; do not generalize its rates to other languages or task formats.
代码测试本身不是完美判据：作者发现 CoderEval 中有空壳实现也能通过的题目，缺失上下文或歧义需求也会造成表面上的评审错误。摘要研究只覆盖选出的长函数与九名标注者。复用前应独立审计目标仓库的测试集，并做人类校准；不能把本文错误率推广到其他语言或任务格式。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this protocol when evaluating a code generator or summarizer with a candidate LLM judge: first clean the executable oracle or assemble triple human labels, then measure false positives, failures, and bias before automating selection. The output is a calibrated evaluation report, not a trusted reward signal. Do not use it when no independent oracle or review budget exists.
若要用候选大语言模型评估代码生成器或摘要器，可复用本协议：先清理可执行判据或建立三人标注，再测量假阳性、失败和偏差，之后才考虑自动化选择。输出应是经校准的评测报告，而非可直接信任的奖励信号。没有独立判据或复核预算时不适用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: tests LLM judging for code correctness and summary quality.
  • Lever: compare prompts and judges against cleaned executable tests or triple human labels.
  • Artifact: a 1,163-summary public human-judgment dataset and replication package.
  • Evidence: GPT-4-turbo is best but accepts wrong code in 50% of reported cases.
  • Reuse: calibrate on target tasks; never treat an unvalidated judge as an oracle.

• 定位：检验大语言模型评审代码正确性与摘要质量的能力。
  • 抓手：以清理后的可执行测试或三人标注为对照，比较提示词与评审模型。
  • 材料：公开 1,163 条摘要的人类判断数据和复现实验包。
  • 证据：GPT-4-turbo 最佳，却仍将报告中错误代码的 50% 判为正确。
  • 复用：必须在目标任务校准，未经验证的评审不能充当判据。
